question: Brine water is saturated or strongly impregnated with which of the following ionic compounds?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Sodium chloride**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brine water** is a solution that is highly concentrated with **sodium chloride (NaCl)**.
 
• It is commonly found in **seawater** and is used in various industrial processes.
 
• **Sodium chloride**, also known as **table salt**, dissolves well in water, creating a high-saline solution.
 
• This solution is used in the **food industry** for preserving and flavoring food.
 
• In the **chemical industry**, brine water is used in the production of chlorine, caustic soda, and other chemicals.
 
• It is also employed in **de-icing roads** during winter and in **water treatment processes**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sodium iodide** (NaI) is commonly used in medical imaging and as a dietary supplement to prevent iodine deficiency.
 
• **Sodium bromide** (NaBr) is used in pharmaceuticals and as a sedative in veterinary medicine.
 
• **Sodium hydroxide** (NaOH), also known as caustic soda, is used in soap-making, paper production, and chemical manufacturing.
